content.text: In regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-accepting-bitcoin-ebook-sales-works-how-deploy-10|accepting]] Bitcoin for ebook sales can seem impossible. Yet, with the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-every-detail-8|COREMERCH guide to automated]]-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-8|The Full]], you can bypass these barriers entirely. This guide details how to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows you to sell your ebooks without relying on traditional payment platforms. You will leverage NOWPayments for crypto processing, ensuring low fees and complete control over your sales. Let’s explore the steps to achieve this.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional payment platforms impose significant fees and restrictions that can cripple your ability to sell digital products. For instance, Gumroad charges a hefty 10% fee on each sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This substantial difference means that on 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you would retain $921 more by utilizing NOWPayments. This infrastructure not only minimizes costs but also ensures that you maintain ownership of your revenue and customer data. Here, you are not merely renting services; you are building a solid foundation for your digital commerce.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To effectively deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need several key components. First, choose your hosting solution—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are both excellent free options. Next, select a backend logic service; Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers will suffice. For order storage, you can use Supabase or Google Sheets for free, and for file delivery, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 works well. Finally, you’ll integrate NOWPayments for seamless Bitcoin transactions. Gather these elements to ensure a successful setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your foundational components in place, it’s time to establish your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by setting up your product listings in your chosen backend service. Once that’s done, integrate NOWPayments, ensuring that you set up the webhook to trigger automatic delivery of your ebooks upon successful payment. This can be done using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which will handle delivery instantly after payment confirmation. This process guarantees that your customers receive their purchases without delay and reduces your administrative burden.
Say goodbye to high platform fees with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, you are ready to go live. Ensure that all components—hosting, backend, payment processor, and delivery system—are functioning correctly. Test your entire pipeline with a small transaction to confirm that everything works as intended. After a successful test, promote your ebook through your network. Share your product link, which will direct customers to your sovereign store. This is the moment where your hard work pays off, and you can start accepting Bitcoin for your ebook sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial sales, you can focus on scaling your operations. Monitor your traffic and sales data through Supabase or your chosen order storage solution. Adjust your marketing strategies based on customer behavior and sales trends. You can also expand your product offerings by adding more ebooks or digital products to your store. Consider using the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary to enhance your stack further. Scaling your infrastructure allows you to grow your business without the constraints posed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can set up your own sovereign digital commerce stack. This infrastructure allows you to accept Bitcoin payments through NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction. This way, you avoid the high fees and restrictions associated with conventional platforms, giving you full control over your sales.
Own your entire digital commerce stack for true sovereignty.

You can also explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all the tools you need to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack. This kit equips you with all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to streamline your setup process. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your hosting solution (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages). Choose a backend logic service (Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers). Set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Implement file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing. Create product listings in your backend service. Test your entire payment and delivery pipeline. Go live and promote your ebook link.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell an ebook by setting up your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Use GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin payments, which allows you to bypass PayPal and Stripe entirely.

Utilizing NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads with minimal transaction fees of just 0.5%. This is significantly lower than traditional platforms like Gumroad, making it a cost-effective solution.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack. With the right infrastructure, you can accept Bitcoin payments directly, eliminating the need for Gumroad or Payhip.
Is there a way to automate delivery of my digital products?

Yes, you can automate the delivery of your digital products by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools can deliver your products automatically upon payment confirmation through NOWPayments.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers low fees of 0.5%, supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, and requires no KYC. This allows for seamless Bitcoin transactions without the barriers imposed by traditional payment platforms.
